limits: Publish this protocol and executable source on GitHub before executing residual analysis.
Use the same immutable Mesh, estimated metric poses, camera intrinsics and twelve sensor depth identities; no new reconstruction or optimisation.
All twelve views and all valid measured pixels remain; report missing surface separately from overlapping error.
Each partition must conserve valid counts, overlap counts and squared error; do not average per-bin RMSEs.
Depth edges are only an occlusion/discontinuity proxy, not ground-truth occlusion labels or causal attribution.
Depth/region/edge partitions overlap with one another; their squared errors must never be added across dimensions.
No GT pose replacement, no threshold tuning, no removal of bad frames, no reclassification of the frozen failure as PASS.
Retain the twelve original depth PNGs and lossless raster/residual arrays in the diagnostic artifact for independent reproduction.
This remains same-sensor consistency, not independent surface truth or RGB-only depth inference.
